components.title: Implement core merge logic
components.what: Copy each [start,end] pair (do not mutate input, no shared references), sort copies by start (ties broken by end or irrelevant), then iterate merging current into last when current.start <= last.end, else append; use <= so touching intervals like [1,4],[4,5] merge.

components.title: Handle empty and single-interval inputs
components.what: Return [] immediately for empty list; single-interval list returns a copy of that interval unmerged.

components.title: Verify non-mutation and output shape
components.what: Ensure original input list and its inner lists are unchanged after call (test via equality check against a saved deep copy); ensure every returned element is a two-element list of ints, not tuples.
